headline: BAL @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 4.23 at TOR 4.08, with a projected total of 8.30. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (BAL +0.26, TOR +0.15), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.41, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Kyle Bradish has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Alonso, Nathan Lukes, Ernie Clement, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Weston Wilson, Myles Straw because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
